name: Outline
description: Represents an outline on a worksheet.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: When used without an object qualifier, this property returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Excel application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which this object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent object for the specified object. Read-only.

properties.name: AutomaticStyles
properties.description: True if the outline uses automatic styles. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: SummaryColumn
properties.description: Returns or sets the location of the summary columns in the outline. Read/write XlSummaryColumn.

properties.name: SummaryRow
properties.description: Returns or sets the location of the summary rows in the outline. Read/write XlSummaryRow.

methods.name: ShowLevels
methods.signature: ShowLevels([RowLevels As Variant], [ColumnLevels As Variant]) As Variant
methods.description: Displays the specified number of row and/or column levels of an outline.

parameters.name: RowLevels
parameters.description: Specifies the number of row levels of an outline to display. If the outline has fewer levels than the number specified, Microsoft Excel displays all the levels. If this argument is 0 (zero) or is omitted, no action is taken on rows.

parameters.name: ColumnLevels
parameters.description: Specifies the number of column levels of an outline to display. If the outline has fewer levels than the number specified, Excel displays all the levels. If this argument is 0 (zero) or is omitted, no action is taken on columns.
